name: 1 Samuel
author: Not named in the text. Often thought to rely on earlier records.
date: Covers about 1100 to 1010 BC. Final form is often dated after the kingdom divided.
setting: Israel moves from tribal rule under Eli and Samuel to the monarchy under Saul, with David rising.
theme: God gives Israel a king, rejects Saul for disobedience, and chooses David.

outline.label: Jonathan’s victory and Saul’s rash oath
David anointed and brought to Saul
Nob and the cave of Adullam
Saul pursues, and David spares him

christInBook: David, the anointed shepherd king from Bethlehem, anticipates the greater Son of David. Hannah’s song (2:1-10) speaks of God’s “anointed” and foreshadows Mary’s song in Luke 1.
howToRead: The book turns on a contrast between outward and inward: Saul looks like a king, while David is a man after God’s heart. Pay attention to who is listening to God and who is not.
